review_candidates.title: Azure Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Azure Platform Engineer FLSA Classification: Exempt Revision Date: 11/6/26 Role Type: Remote or Hybrid (Jacksonville/Nashville) Reports To: Senior Director of Cloud Operations About Mosai Mosai™ is the intelligent care coordination platform that brings together the fragmented pieces of healthcare into a clear, connected picture. Like a mosaic, our platform unites data, people, and processes so providers can make better decisions, coordinate care in real time, and deliver improved outcomes. With Mosai, home-based care organizations can thrive in value-based care while giving every patient the right care, in the right place, at the right time. Learn more at https://www.mosai.com/ Position Summary The Azure Platform Engineer builds and supports the Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automation that form the internal platform our engineering teams use to deliver software reliably and securely. Working hands-on with AKS, Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure Bicep, and application and transport-layer networking (OSI layers 3–7), you will partner with software development, operations, and quality assurance teams to improve continuous integration, continuous delivery, infrastructure automation, and release reliability. You will work under the guidance of senior engineers while taking ownership of well-defined projects and tasks. In this role, you will help build and run the AKS-based platform that supports reliable product delivery, scalable cloud infrastructure, and consistent, self-service deployment standards across engineering teams, while growing your technical skills. Job Duties Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including cluster configuration, scaling, upgrades, and ingress, and escalate complex issues as needed. Maintain platform tooling and processes across AKS, Azure, Azure DevOps, and Azure Bicep, collaborating with software development, operations, and quality assurance teams to streamline continuous integration, continuous delivery, and automation, with guidance from senior team members. Develop and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) using Azure Bicep to provision and manage cloud resources in Azure, supporting scalability, performance, and security. Build, maintain, and improve Azure DevOps pipelines for building, testing, and deploying applications, including pipeline configuration, integrations, and security. Apply secure DevOps practices, including secrets management, least-privilege access, and vulnerability scanning in pipelines and infrastructure, in support of security and HIPAA compliance requirements. Support and troubleshoot application and network traffic at OSI layers 4–7, including TCP/UDP load balancing, TLS/SSL certificates, HTTP/HTTPS routing, DNS, and Kubernetes ingress, working with Azure networking services such as Azure Load Balancer and Application Gateway, and escalating complex issues to senior engineers. Configure and use monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (such as Datadog, Azure Monitor, and Log Analytics) and participate in the on-call rotation to respond to and resolve production incidents and pipeline or infrastructure issues. Participate in code and pipeline reviews and learn from senior engineers to build technical skills and follow best practices. Build and document reusable platform components, such as pipeline templates, Bicep modules, and Helm charts, that give development teams self-service deployment capabilities on AKS. All other job-related duties as assigned Minimum Requirements Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 2+ years of DevOps, cloud, or infrastructure experience, including Azure provisioning, automation, access controls, and production support. Experience with Git, including branching, merging, and resolving merge conflicts. Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps pipelines, including pipeline creation, configuration, integration, and release automation. Working experience with Azure Bicep (or similar IaC tools such as Terraform or ARM templates) for provisioning and managing Azure resources. Knowledge of scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, or other relevant technologies. Hands-on experience deploying and operating workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or Kubernetes, with Docker and containerization. Working knowledge of networking at OSI layers 4–7, including TCP/UDP, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, load balancing, and reverse proxies. Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Willingness to participate in and contribute to the team's on-call rotation, including occasional after-hours support. Preferred Skills And Experience Experience with Helm and AKS cluster operations such as node pools, upgrades, and autoscaling (ideal candidate) Experience with Azure networking and traffic management services (Application Gateway, Load Balancer, Front Door, Azure Firewall), Kubernetes ingress controllers, or service mesh Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana, or Prometheus Familiarity with secure DevOps practices (secrets management, least-privilege access, vulnerability scanning) and HIPAA or other compliance requirements in a healthcare environment Azure (e.g., AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-700) or Kubernetes (e.g., CKA, CKAD) certifications are a plus. Physical Demands of Our Work Environment This position uses a computer and other office equipment as needed to perform duties. The in-office noise level in the work environment is typical of that of an office. Frequent interruptions may be encountered throughout the workday. The employee is required to stand or sit, talk, and hear frequently, and to use repetitive keying or hand motions. The physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Work Environment This position is open to applicants who currently reside in, or are willing to work from, one of the following states: FL, GA, IA, IN, KY, MI, MO, MS, NC, NE, NM, PA, SC, TN, TX. The Company reserves the right to update the list of eligible states at any time. Occasional travel required Ability to work weekends, nights, or be on-call as a regular part of the job Mosai is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status, If you are unable to submit an application because of a incompatible assistive technology or disability, please contact us at careers@mosai.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for disability assistance as soon as possible. Mosai is an E-verify employer. Your eligibility to work in the United States will be verified through the E-verify system if you apply and are selected for a position. Be aware of employment fraud. All email communications from Mosai or its hiring managers originate from @mosai.com or addresses. We will never ask you for payment or require you to purchase any equipment. If you are suspicious or unsure about the validity of a job posting, we strongly encourage you to apply directly through our website.

Our approach begins and ends with establishing trust, accountability, and transparency. Our company values of creative spirit, pride of ownership, follow-through, and a team-first attitude drive us to pursue our mission every day. Our culture supports our values by fostering innovative and critical thinking and a deep belief in living up to our promises. Headquartered in the United States, Pattern has a global portfolio of more than 30 power facilities and transmission assets, serving various customers that provide low-cost clean energy to millions of consumers. Responsibilities JOB PURPOSE Responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining automated infrastructure solutions across Azure Platform environments. This role ensures consistent deployment practices, secure configurations, and scalable infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and Ansible. The DevOps Automation Engineer collaborates with Data Platform and Product teams teams to streamline CI/CD pipelines, enhance system reliability, and support agile delivery of cloud-native applications. As a Platform Engineer, the DevOps Automation Engineer can originate new platform capabilities as they relate to infrastructure automation. Key Accountabilities Major Accountabilities Platform Architecture Design and Review CI/CD Pipeline Implementation & Maintenance AI Infrastructure & Container Platform Engineering Infrastructure automation and IaC Development AI-Assisted Operations & Copilot Integration Monitoring, Logging, and Performance Optimization Documentation & Knowledge Sharing Qualifications Experience/Qualifications/Education Required Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform and Ansible to deploy cloud-native structures. Deep experience with Azure Container Solutions, specifically architecting, securing, and scaling applications within Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Azure Container Registry (ACR). Hands-on experience with Azure AI Infrastructure, including provisioning, securing, and managing Azure AI Foundry (formerly Azure AI Studio), Azure OpenAI Service, and vector databases. Strong understanding of Enterprise Azure Networking, including Hub-Spoke architecture, Azure Firewall, ExpressRoute/VPN, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Private Endpoints, and private link integrations for secure AI and data workloads. Experience integrating AI-assisted development tools, such as configuring, managing, or optimizing GitHub Copilot / Microsoft Copilot environments and guardrails for engineering teams. Robust knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions), automated testing frameworks for IaC, and git-based workflows. Additional Requirements The DevOps Automation Engineer plays a key role in accelerating cloud adoption and improving operational efficiency through automation. This position supports agile development practices and ensures infrastructure is scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards. This range is an estimate and base pay may be above or below the ranges based on several factors including but not limited to location, work experience, certifications, and education. In addition to base pay, Pattern’s compensation program includes a bonus structure for full-time employees of all levels.
